content: तुला [तुल्-भिदा˚ अङ्] .²1 A balance; तस्मात्तेऽद्य प्रदास्यामि स्वमांसं तुलया धृतम् <ls>Mb. 3. 131. 25</ls>; the beam of a balance; तुलया धृ to hold in a balance, to weigh, consider equal; अश्वमेधसहस्राणि सत्यं च तुलया धृतम् <ls>H. 4. 131</ls>, <ab>v. l.</ab> .²2 A measure, weight. .²3 Weighing. .²4 Resemblance, likeness, equality, similarity (with <ab>gen.</ab>, <ab>instr.</ab> or in <ab>comp.</ab>); किं धूर्जटेरिव तुलामुपयाति संख्ये <ls>Ve. 3. 8</ls>; तुलां यदारोहति दन्तवाससा <ls>Ku. 5. 34</ls>; <ls>R. 8. 15</ls>; सद्यः परस्परतुलामधिरोहतां द्वे <ls>R. 5. 68</ls>, <ls n="R.">19. 8</ls>, <ls n="R. 19.">50</ls>. .²5 Libra, the seventh sign of the zodiac; जयति तुलामधिरूढो भास्वानपि जलदपटलानि <ls>Pt. 1. 330</ls>. .²6 A sloping beam or timber in the roof of a house. .²7 A measure of gold or silver equal to 100 {%palas%}. .²8 A kind of beam in the roof of a house (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>तुळई</ns>); <ls>Bṛ. S. 53. 30</ls>.
